name: CrossLoop
summary: Turns a public web page into a narrated launch video in three formats (16:9, 9:16, 4:5) with captions and suggested social copy, sold as one-time credit packs instead of a subscription.
best_for: founders and small SaaS, AI-tool and ecommerce teams who need a narrated launch or promo video for a product page or a Product Hunt or LinkedIn launch, without hiring an editor or paying for a monthly video subscription
skip_if: you need full control over the script and edit, talking-head avatars or long training videos, or you make videos every week and already pay for an editor or a video tool
honest_knock: The money-back guarantee covers only your first purchase, and films are deleted after 30 days, so anything you do not download is gone. The pages we read do not describe editing or revisions: the film is made from what your page says, so a thin page gives a thin film. CrossLoop is run by one named person, Harsha Vardhan, according to the terms, which is worth knowing if you plan to rely on it for a long time.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Launch Film · per one-time, one-time credit packs, no subscription: Launch Film $9 (1 credit), Launch Film Studio $19 (2 credits), Studio Pack 5 films $49 (10 credits), Studio Pack 20 films $129 (40 credits)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-24 on crossloop.ai/pricing, crossloop.ai/terms and crossloop.ai/refund-policy, both last updated 10 October 2026) No subscription: you buy one-time credit packs. Launch Film is $9 for 1 credit, Launch Film Studio $19 for 2 credits (adds Trend Pulse, a script written around this week's news and TikTok trends in your niche), Studio Pack: 5 films $49 for 10 credits and Studio Pack: 20 films $129 for 40 credits, unless a different price is shown at checkout. A Launch film uses 1 credit and a Studio film 2. Narration in your own voice is +$9 a film after recording about 30 seconds once (Launch + your voice $18, Studio + your voice $28). Credits never expire. Each film comes in 16:9, 9:16 and 4:5 with a 30-second Instagram Reel and cover, a captions file (.srt) and LinkedIn and Instagram copy; nine languages are included. There is a 7-day money-back guarantee on the first purchase only, and a failed render returns the credit automatically. Payments run through Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record.

compare_with.name: InVideo
compare_with.why: InVideo is in our dossiers: Starter at $20 per seat a month with 400 credits per seat, read on 24 September 2026, and it turns a prompt or script into a first-draft video you edit yourself. CrossLoop starts from your web page instead of a prompt, costs $9 or $19 per film with no subscription, and hands back a finished film in three formats. InVideo fits a team that makes video every month and wants to edit; CrossLoop fits an occasional launch video.
